purpose: Teach: 本校/（財）/先ごろ/片っ端/遅ればせながら/討ち/新報/追いつめ

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本校、つまり本校の生徒関連事案を、警察、慎重に対応されますね
lines.en: Regarding this case—involving students from this school—the police are handling it carefully, aren't they?
lines.style: Measured, searching tone. Ren is testing the officer's awareness and patience. Slight pause before the parenthetical clarification. Genuinely curious underneath the formal phrasing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、（財）法人、つまり（財）系の不正経理事案も担当されますね
lines.en: The police also handle fraud cases involving foundations and corporate misconduct, don't they?
lines.style: Professional acknowledgment. Officer Takeda matches Ren's register without condescension. Even, competent delivery. A small nod in the voice—recognizing the question's legitimacy.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、先ごろ報道された事件を、警察、再調査されますね
lines.en: Regarding this case—the incident that was reported recently—the police are reinvestigating it, aren't they?
lines.style: Slight pressure now. Ren's phrasing becomes more pointed, less deferential. Still respectful, but testing whether the officer will acknowledge the full scope. Lean slightly forward in tone.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、現場周辺を片っ端から聞き込みされますね
lines.en: The police conduct thorough canvassing around the scene, interviewing anyone and everyone nearby, don't they?
lines.style: Calm, methodical. Officer Takeda's voice settles into explanation mode—not defensive, simply laying out procedure. Each phrase gets equal weight. Reassuring in its thoroughness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、遅ればせながら証拠を提出した参考人を、警察、慎重に聴かれますね
lines.en: Regarding this case—the witness who submitted evidence belatedly—the police would question them carefully, wouldn't they?
lines.style: Ren's tone hardens slightly. The repeated structure is becoming rhythmic, almost formal. He's building toward something. Breathe before 'witness.' Steady but with quiet insistence underneath.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、暴力事案で「討ち取った」、つまり制圧した容疑者の聴取もされますね
lines.en: The police also interrogate suspects in cases of violence—those who were, shall we say, subdued during arrest—don't they?
lines.style: Officer Takeda's response grows cooler, more guarded. The euphemism lands deliberately. No apology in the delivery, but a shift: he's aware Ren is circling something specific. Measured, slightly tighter.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、新報、つまり新報社からの取材対応もされますね
lines.en: Regarding this case—the police also handle media inquiries from news organizations, don't they?
lines.style: Ren broadens back out, but the damage is done. He's acknowledged the scope. Quieter attack on this one—he's shifting tone. Less confrontational, more observational. Testing if the officer will relax.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者を追いつめ、つまり追い詰めて自供させる捜査もされますね
lines.en: The police also conduct investigations where they corner suspects—corner them, that is—to elicit confessions, don't they?
lines.style: Officer Takeda's voice drops and hardens. The repeated word is no longer explanation; it's accusation, gentle but unmistakable. He's not answering anymore—he's acknowledging what Ren has been circling. Brief, final, the tone of someone who will not be pushed further.
